Ruthin Castle Hotel
DENBIGHSHIRE, NORTH WALES
Ruthin Castle is a beautiful retreat; steeped in history and situated within the glorious Clwydian Range in North Wales.
Set in acres of immaculate gardens and sprawling woodland, this four-star castle hotel embraces its royal heritage with traditional interiors and top class facilities. The Tafarn Y Ddraig serves up local & seasonal produce. BAZAAR Spa nestled in the former moat of the castle features woodland hot tubs, thermal escapes and soothing treatments.
Based in the heart of the pretty town of Ruthin, the Castle is a renowned wedding venue , along with the perfect base for a break in stunning North Wales. Wonderful walks, exciting hiking and challenging cycling are all on the doorstep whilst the glorious Snowdonia National Park & sunny beaches of Llandudno are just a short drive away.

The grounds of the castle where delightful with some amazing views and plenty of space to wonder around.

Location
RUTHIN CASTLE
Ruthin Castle is located within acres of parkland in the heart of the Medieval town of Ruthin, North Wales. Ruthin is easily accessible from North West England, just 22 miles west of Chester, 38 miles from Liverpool and 55 miles from Manchester.
The Castle is located on Castle Street, just off the main Town Square in the direction of Corwen. Look out for the stone entrance archway. If you're lucky, a number of our resident peacocks may be out to greet you as you proceed along the driveway. Free parking is available for our guests.
FROM BIRMINGHAM & THE SOUTH (M6)
From the M6 join the M54 towards Telford. At the end of the M54 join the A5 and follow signs for North Wales & Llangollen. At Llangollen turn right into the Town Centre, crossing the river, & then left at the T-Junction.
Follow signs for Ruthin leading across the Horseshoe Pass go straight over the next roundabout, then turn left at the T-Junction. Stay on this road travelling through the Nant-y-Garth Pass, continuing to follow signs for Ruthin.
FROM MANCHESTER & THE EAST (M56)
From the M6 join the M56 (signposted Chester & North Wales) at Junction 20. Follow the M56 to its end and continue toward the A55 following North Wales'. Exit the A55 following signs for Mold. Ruthin is then clearly signposted from Mold on the A545.
BY RAIL
From Chester railway station, we recommend either renting a car or taking a taxi.
BY AIR
Liverpool John Lennon Airport is 45 miles, whilst Manchester International Airport is 48 miles away. Car rental is available at both airports. A helicopter landing-pad is available on the estate. For co-ordinates and to make arrangements for landing, please contact us.

ACCOMMODATION
AT RUTHIN CASTLE
Legendary Ruthin Castle has been welcoming guests including Kings & Queens and noted members of society for several hundred years & today, that long history of delivering warm hospitality & comfort to guests continues.
The Castle offers five room styles across 60 bedrooms. All of our guest rooms blend the original era of Ruthin Castle with modern comfort & offer a range of facilities including complimentary WiFi.
